compiled_state.title: UPDATE: Add recipe consultation step and recipe: task type to SKILL.md
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Update plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md to:
1. Add a Recipe Consultation step in Step 1 (Contextual Discovery) that calls consult-recipe-registry.sh and uses the output to recognize recipe-eligible transforms
2. Add guidance in Step 3 (Atomic Task Drafting) for recipe: task type assignment: when to assign it and what the task spec must include (recipe_name, recipe_params, intent from capability_description)

## Why
Instruction-file update: the LLM executing the implementation-plan skill needs explicit guidance to call the helper, recognize recipe capabilities, and emit recipe: typed task specs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- SKILL.md Step 1 (Contextual Discovery) includes a Recipe Consultation subsection instructing: call `bash $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/implementation-plan/consult-recipe-registry.sh` and record available recipe capabilities
- SKILL.md Step 3 (Atomic Task Drafting) includes guidance: when a task is a mechanical transform matching a recipe capability, assign testing_mode: recipe: and include fields: recipe_name (from registry name field), recipe_params (key=value pairs for the transform), intent (natural-language description from capability_description)
- SKILL.md guidance is specific enough that an LLM would recognize add-parameter and normalize-imports as recipe-eligible tasks and would NOT assign recipe: to business logic tasks
- Existing tests remain still-valid (no executable behavior change in SKILL.md itself)

## File Impact
- MODIFY: plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — instruction-file change; tests still-valid

## Dependencies
- 00fa-27e6 (script must exist before SKILL.md can reliably reference it)
